name: Nem lui
summary: Nem lui is grilled pork on a lemongrass skewer, pork ground with fish sauce and shallot, wrapped in rice paper with herbs. Vietnam Tourism says the vendors are on the street and does not name the street. A stall price is check on arrival.
origin: Hue street snack. The national page describes the pork, the wrap, and a creamy sauce, and leaves the street unnamed.
howToEat: Wrap the skewer in rice paper with herbs, pineapple, bean sprouts, green banana, and chili, then the creamy sauce.
The national page says vendors are on the street. It does not name the street. Check on arrival.
A clock hour is check on arrival. It is a snack, not a named dinner.
where: A Hue street stall. The street name is check on arrival. No shop is a pick on this page.
seoTitle: Nem lui in Hue — grilled pork skewers from a street stall
seoDescription: Grilled pork on a lemongrass skewer, wrapped in rice paper with herbs. The street is check on arrival, and so is the stall price.
